props.text: Check-ups, children's health, blood tests and small procedures, with lab results sent to your phone the same evening.

image.alt: A doctor talking with a patient in a consulting room

props.heading: Opening hours
props.note: We are a day clinic. In an emergency, go to the nearest hospital emergency department or call 102 for an ambulance.

props.heading: What people see us for
props.intro: Walk in or book ahead. A doctor sees you, and anything that needs a specialist gets a written referral the same day.

items.title: General medicine
items.text: Fever, stomach trouble, coughs that will not go away, and a second opinion on a prescription.

items.title: Children's health
items.text: Growth checks, vaccines on the national schedule, and sick visits the same day.

items.title: Women's health
items.text: Check-ups, pregnancy tests and antenatal visits with a woman doctor on Sundays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

items.title: Diabetes and blood pressure
items.text: Regular follow-up with your readings kept in one file, and a reminder when the next test is due.

items.title: Lab tests
items.text: Blood, urine and thyroid tests. Samples before 10:00 get results by SMS the same evening.

items.title: Small procedures
items.text: Dressings, stitches and their removal, ear cleaning, nebulisation.

image.alt: A bottle of tablets on a white surface

props.heading: A pharmacy open the same hours
props.body: Fill your prescription before you leave. The pharmacist goes through each medicine with you, and writes the doses in Nepali on the packet if you ask.

items.a: No. Walk-ins are seen in order. With a booking you are seen at your time, and we call if the doctor is running late.

items.q: Should I come fasting for blood tests?
items.a: For sugar and lipid tests, yes: nothing but water for ten hours. Other tests do not need it. Ask when you book.

items.q: How do I get my report?
items.a: By SMS with a link, the same evening for samples given before 10:00. Printed copies wait at the front desk.

items.q: Do you take the Health Insurance Board card?
items.a: Not yet. We give an itemised bill you can claim with private insurers.
